scope: Zero-new-sample secondary analysis of the already revealed P429 production block. This contract is not a preregistration and cannot turn the reused production rows into independent confirmation.

inputs.filter: branch_common_safe == 1 within each orientation-specific at-risk table

analysis_unit: One common-safe successor row carrying the paired clone responses (y1,y2). Clone responses are never expanded into independent rows.

dependency_contract.holdout: For each fold, hold out that complete batch set simultaneously in both orientations and both sizes.
dependency_contract.nuisance_fit: One joint model across all four size-orientation environments, with four unpenalized environment intercepts and common feature slopes.
dependency_contract.uncertainty: Batch-cluster sandwich covariance of held-out pair scores. The two orientations remain coupled inside each size-batch vector; size blocks are reported separately and are not meta-analysed into independent evidence.

model.environment_weighting: equal total training weight for each size-orientation environment
model.standardization: training-fold, within-environment mean and standard deviation; standardized values clipped to [-8,8]; binary multiple_carriers remains 0/1
model.selection: No tuning, feature selection, interaction search, or outcome-adaptive knots. All candidate states use the same five folds and fixed ridge penalty.

estimands.heldout_residual_dependence: mean[(y1-m_hat(X))*(y2-m_hat(X))] on held-out batches, using one symmetry-locked m_hat for both clones
estimands.absorbed_dependence: intercept-only held-out residual dependence minus candidate-state held-out residual dependence
estimands.heldout_log_loss: mean of the two clone Bernoulli log losses within each row
estimands.heldout_brier: mean of the two clone squared errors within each row
estimands.block_increment: current nested candidate minus the immediately preceding candidate on the absorbed-dependence and loss-improvement scales

degeneracy_audit.cooperative_label_boundary: The three cooperative coordinates are checkpoint boundary-contact proxies, not the exact two-step cooperative pair count.

claim_boundary: Descriptive, post-reveal, zero-new-sample mechanism allocation at two fixed checkpoints. Cross-fitting limits in-sample prediction bias but does not establish causal mediation, full-state sufficiency, scaled Markov closure, a continuum memory field, or a scale exponent.
